intro: Amity University Haryana and K.R. Mangalam University both sit in Gurgaon, and this page compares their recorded MBA / PGDM fees, placements, admission routes and campus setting, using our database and official pages we opened in 2026.

Amity University Haryana vs K.R. Mangalam University is not a single winner. Both are recorded as private institutes. Amity University Haryana holds a NIRF 2025 rank of 101; K.R. Mangalam University has no NIRF rank on this page.

sections.heading: Amity University Haryana vs K.R. Mangalam University for MBA / PGDM: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose Amity University Haryana if its MBA / PGDM programme, location and recorded outcomes match the kind of work or further study you want, including the stronger NIRF 2025 rank on this page.
Choose K.R. Mangalam University if its course mix, city or recorded fee level is the better fit, rather than looking for one campus that wins on every count.

Amity University Haryana lists Executive MBA, MBA (Banking and Financial Services), MBA (Business Analytics) and more. K.R. Mangalam University lists MBA (Digital Marketing) with academic support of Imarticus Learning, MBA with academic support of IBM, MBA with Academic Support of IBM Entreprenuership and more.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: On this page we quote a programme total when we hold a Total Fees record, and we skip application, hostel-only or short-course rows so a registration fee is not treated as tuition.

Our records list ₹4.54 lakh a year as total fees for Amity University Haryana's MBA (Banking and Financial Services). Treat that as a year figure, not a confirmed full-programme total, until you check the official notice.

Our records list ₹2.8 lakh a year as total fees for K.R. Mangalam University's MBA with Academic Support of IBM International Business. Treat that as a year figure, not a confirmed full-programme total, until you check the official notice.
If fees are your only filter, confirm the current official circular for the exact programme and batch you will join, because year figures and older rows can understate the real cost.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: In our records, Amity University Haryana's 2022 figures are an average of ₹6 lakh and a highest of ₹30 lakh for MBA Marketing & Sales. These are historical batch outcomes, not a salary promise.

In our records, K.R. Mangalam University's 2022 figures are an average of ₹8 lakh and a highest of ₹11 lakh for MBA with Academic Support of IBM Entreprenuership. These are historical batch outcomes, not a salary promise.
If you are comparing offers, use the latest official placement report from each institute and match the programme name, not an executive or certificate batch.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Amity University Haryana's recorded admission tests on this page include CAT.
K.R. Mangalam University's recorded admission tests on this page include CAT.
Eligibility wording can change by cycle. Use the current official admission brochure rather than last year's cut-off stories.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in Gurgaon, Haryana. The choice is less about moving city and more about the programme, fees and admission route.
Visit both campuses if you can, or at least read the official hostel and location notes, before you accept an offer.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: If you want the stronger recorded public standing or NIRF rank in this pair, Amity University Haryana is the safer first pick, after you have checked official fees and seats.
K.R. Mangalam University can still be the better fit if its specialisation, city or recorded fee level matches what you can join this year.
If fees are the only filter, do not use the lowest number in our raw rows. Check each official fee notice for the exact programme and batch you will join.
